ड: ड The third letter of the cerebral class of consonants, having the sound of D, pronounced far back in the head: it is often confounded in pronounciation with a hard R, or L, sounded as in the Northumbrian bur; it is written in the Roman character D.

ड m. (डः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 Fear. 3 Sound. 4 Submarine fire. 5 A kind of drum or tabor. f. (डा) 1 A kind of female imp or goblin. 2 A basket, &c. carried by a sling: see डलक. E. डप to collect, affix ड.
डङ्गरी: डङ्गरी f. (-री) A kind of gourd; also read डङ्गारी.
डप: डप r. 10th cl. (डापयति) (इ) डपि r. 1st and 10th cls. (डम्पति डम्पयति) To collect, to accumulate, to heap together.
डब: डब r. 10th cl. (इ) डबि (डम्बयति) To throw, to send, to order. With वि prefixed, to deceive, to disgrace.
डभ: डभ (इ) डभि r. 1st and 10th cls. (डम्भति डम्भयति-ते) To collect, to heap together.
डम: डम m. (-मः) A man of a low caste, employed to clear away filth, &c.
डमर: डमर mf. (-रः-रा) 1 An affray, a conflict without weapons. 2 Terrifying an enemy by shouts and gestures. 3 Petty or predatory warfare, war carried on by detachments or by villages, one in which kings are not engaged. 4 Rout, riot. n. (-रं) Flight, running away through fear. E. डम् imitative sound, and अर what occasions, from ऋ to go, affix अप्.
डमरु: डमरु m. (-रुः) 1 A musical instrument, a sort of small drum, shaped like an hour glass, and held in one hand. 2 Any thing surprising, any strange occurrence, &c. E. डम् imitative sound, ऋ to go or get, कु affix, and the vowel changed.
डयन: डयन n. (-नं) 1 A car or litter carried upon menś shoulders, a Palanquin, a Dūli. 2 Flying in the air, the flight of a bird. E. डी to fly, aff. ल्युट्.
डलक: डलक m. (-कं) A sling, a basket, a dūlī carried on menś shoulders by means of a stick and ropes like the beam and strings of a balance; presents of fruit, sweetmeats, &c. are usually sent in this manner; also read डल्लक.
डहु: डहु m. (-हुः) A tree, (Artocarpus lacucha.) E. दह to burn, affix कु, and the deriv. irr.; also with कू affix डहू, m. (-हूः)
डाकिनी: डाकिनी f. (-नी) A kind of female imp or evil being.
डामर: डामर m. (-रः) 1 Affray, conflict without weapons, &c. see डमर. 2 Rout, uproar, the bustle and the confusion of festivity or strife. 3 Any surprising thing, sight or occurrence. 4 A name common to six Tantras, as the Śivaḍāmara, Yogaḍāmara, Durgāḍāmara, &c. E. डमर q. v. and अण् aff.
डालिम: डालिम m. (-मः) A pomegranate: see दाडिम.
डाहल: डाहल m. (-लः) The name of a country; also Tripura: see त्रिपुर.
डाहुक: डाहुक m. (-कः) A gallinule. E. दह to consume, (disease,) उकञ् affix, the flesh being considered medicinal: the radical initial is changed.
डिङ्गर: डिङ्गर m. (-रः) 1 Throwing, sending. 2 A fat man. 3 A servent, a slave. 4 A rogue, a cheat. 5 A low or depraved man.
डिण्डिम: डिण्डिम m. (-मः) 1 A musical instrument, a kind of small drum or tabor. 2 A plant, bearing a small fruit, (Carissa carandas:) see कृष्णपाक. E. डिण्डि imitative sound, a din, and म what emits, from मि, with ड aff.
डिण्डिर: डिण्डिर m. (-रः) Cuttle fish bone, considered to be the foam of the sea.
डिप: डिप r. 4th cl. (इर) डिपिर (डिप्यति) r. 6th cl. (डिपति) and r. 10th cl. (डेपयति) To throw, to cast, to send or order, to direct: see टिप. r. 10th cl. (डेपयति-ते) also (इ) डिपि r. 1st and 10th cls. (डिम्पति) and (डिम्पयति-ते) To collect, to heap together.
डिब: डिब r. 10th cl. (इ) डिबि (डिम्बयति) To cast, to throw.
डिभ: डिभ (इ) डिभि r. 1st and 10th cls. (डिम्भति and डिम्भयति-ते) To collect, to heap together.
डिम: डिम m. (-मः) A dramatic entertainment, dramatic exhibition of battle or siege, such as the Tripuradāha, in which the destruction of the three cities of TRIPURA by ŚIVA is dramatised. E. डिम्ब affray, &c. deriv. irr.
डिम्ब: डिम्ब m. (-म्बः) 1 Affray, assault, conflict without weapons, mutual defiance, petty and predatory war, &c. see डमर. 2 Sound or noise occasioned by terror. 3 An egg. 4 A chrysalis. 5 The bladder. 6 The spleen. 7 The uterus. 8 Fear, terror. 9 Any young animal. 10 A globe or ball. E. डी to fly, derive irr.
डिम्बाहव: डिम्बाहव m. (-वः) Petty warfare, affray, skirmish, riot, &c. E. डिम्ब as above, and आहव war, battle; also डिम्बयुद्ध, and other similar compounds.
डिम्बिका: डिम्बिका f. (-का) 1 A bubble. 2 A kind of waterfly. 3 A libidinous woman. E. डिम्ब the bladder, &c. कन् aff.
डिम्भ: डिम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 Any young animal. 2 A fool, an idiot, a blockhead. f. (-म्भा) An infant. E. डिभि to collect, affix अच्; कन् being added; also डिम्भक.
डिम्भचक्र: डिम्भचक्र n. (-क्रं) A diagram for telling fortunes.
डी: डी (ङ) डीङ् r. 1st and 4th cls. (डयते डीयते) 1 To fly, to pass through the air. 2 To go, to move. With अव prefixed, To fly down, to alight. With उत्, To fly up, to soar. With परि, To fly round. With प्र, To fly well or swiftly. With सम्, To fly well or in flocks. With सम् and उत्, To fly up by degrees.
डीन: डीन n. (-नं) Flying, the flight of a bird. E. डी to fly, affix ल्युट्.
डीनडीनक: डीनडीनक m. (-कः) Flying reiteratedly. E. डीन flying, reduplicated, कन् added.
डीनावडीन: डीनावडीन n. (-नं) 1 Flying up and down. 2 Flying ill. E. डीन, and अवडीन alighting.
डुण्डु: डुण्डु m. (-ण्डुः) A kind of snake, (Amphisbæna.)
डुण्डुभ: डुण्डुभ m. (-भः) A kind of snake, (Amphisbæna.) E. डुण्डु, and भ from भा to shine or resemble.
डुन्दुक: डुन्दुक m. (-कः) A gallinule: see डाहुक.
डुलि: डुलि f. (-लिः) 1 A small turtle. 2 A female turtle: see दुलि.
डुलिका: डुलिका f. (-का) A bird resembling a wagtail.
डोर: डोर n. (-रं) A fillet of thread or cord tied round the arm or wrist; it is also applied to the string tying a packet or parcel; also with कन added डोरक. ढ
